name: Game asset business for artists, musicians, and 3D modelers
summary: Sell your creative work into the games industry through asset marketplaces that pay 70–90% revenue shares. Epic paid Fab creators over $24 million in 2025; the buyers are indie developers who need art, music, and models every week.

endpoints.description: Creative-skill earnings map for the games industry
Roblox niche viability check with live data

payment.pricing_note: Prices shown are the live public catalog — the same wholesale sheet agents pay per call. No subscription.

API: POST https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/api/wholesale/register {contact, scope: "gamepulse"}. Email fallback: info@theaslangroupllc.com with subject "Starter key: game-asset-creator".

setup_steps: Run the earnings map for your craft and pick your two launch marketplaces from the payout table.
Study the top 20 sellers in your category on each: what do their previews, descriptions, and price points have in common. That is the quality bar, and it is visible for free.
Produce one small pack aimed at a gap you found, not your dream project. Finished and listed beats ambitious and unfinished.
List it on both marketplaces with honest previews, then start pack two the same week. Catalog is the strategy.
Set a research rhythm: one niche check before each new pack, so every production month starts with evidence.
licensing_notes: Your obligations run in two directions. Downstream: every listing carries a license you grant buyers, and the marketplace templates handle it; read them once so you know what you’re promising. Upstream: everything you sell must be yours to sell — no third-party IP, no fan-art of protected characters, and if you use AI tools in your workflow, disclose it where the marketplace requires (Fab requires tagging). Musicians should learn the two-license structure (sync for the composition, master use for the recording) before any custom placement deal, because it’s how game licensing prices are actually built.

compliance.earnings: Educational content. No earnings claims or income projections; results depend on operator effort, market, and pricing.
compliance.posture: Flat-fee self-help document preparation where documents are involved: the customer signs and files; the operator never represents clients or works on contingency.
